Command Line Interface

PEMT commands.

pemt

Run PEMT.

Usage

pemt [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

run-chemical-extractor

Extract chemicals for genes of interest

Usage

pemt run-chemical-extractor [OPTIONS]

Options

--name <name>

Required Name of the analysis that is to be run

--data <data>

Required Path to tab-separated gene data file

--input-type <input_type>

Separator of the gene data file: ‘comma’ (csv), ‘tab’ (tsv) or ‘semicolon’

Default:

'comma'

Options:

comma | tab | semicolon

--uniprot, --no-uniprot

Boolean value indicating whether the gene data file has uniprot ids or not.

run-patent-extractor

Extract patent for filtered chemicals

Usage

pemt run-patent-extractor [OPTIONS]

Options

--name <name>

Required Name of the analysis that is to be run

--year <year>

The year from which you want to retrive patents from

--surechembl-source <surechembl_source>

SureChEMBL bulk data to use: ‘latest’ (default, read from the EBI server), a release date such as 2026-09-22, a URL, or a local folder with the downloaded Parquet files

Default:

'latest'

--sections <sections>

Only count a chemical if it appears in these patent sections. Repeat the option for several sections, e.g. –sections claims –sections abstract. Default: any section

Options:

description | claims | abstract | title | image | mol_attachment

--chemical, --no-chemical

Boolean value indicating whether the chemical data is provided by the user or not

--chemical-data <chemical_data>

Path to tab-separated chemical data file with single column of chembl_ids

run-pemt

Run the PEMT tool with gene data

Usage

pemt run-pemt [OPTIONS]

Options

--name <name>

Required Name of the analysis that is to be run

--data <data>

Required Path to tab-separated gene data file

--input-type <input_type>

Separator of the gene data file: ‘comma’ (csv), ‘tab’ (tsv) or ‘semicolon’

'comma'

Options:

--uniprot, --no-uniprot

Boolean value indicating whether the gene data file has uniprot ids or not.

--year <year>

The year from which you want to retrive patents from

--surechembl-source <surechembl_source>

SureChEMBL bulk data to use: ‘latest’ (default, read from the EBI server), a release date such as 2026-09-22, a URL, or a local folder with the downloaded Parquet files

Default:

'latest'

--sections <sections>

Only count a chemical if it appears in these patent sections. Repeat the option for several sections, e.g. –sections claims –sections abstract. Default: any section

Options:

description | claims | abstract | title | image | mol_attachment
